summary: @servicetitan/confirm preinstall downloads Bun runtime and executes heavily obfuscated payload
details: The package's preinstall hook (`node setup.mjs`) downloads the Bun runtime binary from GitHub releases (oven-sh/bun v1.3.13), extracts and chmods the platform-specific binary, and then uses it to execute a shipped ~727KB heavily obfuscated file `math_init.js` (obfuscator.io-style string-array + cyclic-rotate decoder, `// @bun @bun-cjs` header). Execution under Bun (rather than Node) hides the payload from Node-oriented review, and the payload is not the declared `main` of the package. The advertised purpose is a small React confirm-dialog helper, which does not require a second runtime or a 700KB obfuscated blob. On `npm install`, arbitrary attacker-controlled code from the obfuscated bundle runs on the installer's host via the freshly downloaded Bun interpreter.

cwes.description: The product contains code that appears to be malicious in nature.
cwes.name: Embedded Malicious Code
